records.name: Sergeant Quiteenough
records.biography_en: Disapproves of chaos chiefly for its poor timing. His whistle demands an orderly HyperNorm emergency. A dissonant card points out that the emergency has already formed a queue. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Zwischenfall möge sich an die Uhrzeit halten.

variant_notes.note_en: Disapproves of chaos chiefly for its poor timing.

records.name: Signalwoman Missheard
records.biography_en: Repeats every order accurately enough to expose it. She repeats HyperNorm orders down a field telephone until their contradictions become audible. She never edits the embarrassing pauses. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Rückfrage ist eingegangen. Das Schweigen wird geprüft.

variant_notes.note_en: Repeats every order accurately enough to expose it.

records.name: Sapper Underfoot
records.biography_en: Finds solid ground suspicious until he has improved it. His shovel tests every HyperNorm floor officially described as solid. A dissonant card has discovered a softer landing below. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Boden gilt als gesichert. Er wurde gewarnt.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds solid ground suspicious until he has improved it.

records.name: Pilot Cloudledger
records.biography_en: Has excellent bearings and no idea why they brought him here. He unfolds a chart of HyperNorm airspace over a building without windows. A dissonant card suggests opening one. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Orientierung ist tadellos. Es fehlt der Ort.

variant_notes.note_en: Has excellent bearings and no idea why they brought him here.

records.name: Quartermaster Lastpair
records.biography_en: Can issue anything except a second opinion. Her keys open every HyperNorm supply cupboard except the one holding discretionary judgement. She lends the ordinary ones freely. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Zweitausfertigungen sind nur gegen Erstausfertigung erhältlich.

variant_notes.note_en: Can issue anything except a second opinion.

records.name: Highlander Standfast
records.biography_en: Maintains morale at a volume suitable for distant departments. His chanter keeps HyperNorm morale above the permitted volume. A dissonant card hums a second tune and spoils the unison. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Stimmung ist vorhanden und weithin hörbar.

variant_notes.note_en: Maintains morale at a volume suitable for distant departments.
